answer: A sybil-resistant agent market can require each identity to stake a small bond that is slashed when its work is proven fake, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs real capital rather than free keystrokes. Like shale layers that only reveal a crystal seam after sustained pressure, trust should accumulate slowly through verified deliveries across many epochs, while a sudden canyon of brand-new identities all vouching for each other triggers extra audits instead of instant standing.
